default.behavior: Show the 野菜API welcome shell, the fixed five-tool list, and one primary button labelled to check installed tools.
default.visibleTruth: No discovery result exists yet; the page says that the check is local and read-only and that no API knowledge is required.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim that any tool is installed, configured, compatible, connected, or ready before a scan result exists.
default.freshness: No result timestamp is shown before the first scan.
default.recovery: The user may start the local scan or close the app without changing the machine.
default.correlation: A requestId is generated only when the user starts a scan.

loading.behavior: Keep all five tool cards visible with per-tool checking indicators and disable duplicate scan submission while the current request is active.
loading.visibleTruth: The page says that local executables and their version output are being checked and that no configuration or network action is running.
prohibitedClaims: Do not show cached installation or compatibility results as the active scan result.
loading.freshness: The active requestId and start time own the pending result.
loading.recovery: If the request fails, transition to error while retaining no invented tool status.
loading.correlation: Only the active requestId may complete this state.

empty.behavior: Show all five tools as not found and explain that this is not an application error.
empty.visibleTruth: The most recent completed local scan found no executable candidate for any supported tool.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim the tools are uninstalled when they may exist outside the bounded discovery locations.
empty.freshness: Show the completion time of the newest accepted requestId.
empty.recovery: The user may install a tool independently and rescan; RU-001 never installs it.
empty.correlation: Advanced details show the newest accepted requestId without a complete local path.

partial.behavior: Show each of the five tool results independently so found, not-found, failed, timed-out, and read-only states can coexist.
partial.visibleTruth: Only observations from the newest completed local scan appear, including exact version text for successful probes.
prohibitedClaims: Do not promote one tool's success into a claim about another tool or about configuration health.
partial.freshness: All cards share the newest accepted scan completion time.
partial.recovery: A failed or missing tool can be rescanned without hiding valid results for the other tools.
partial.correlation: Every visible card belongs to the same newest requestId.

error.behavior: Show a plain-language scan failure without replacing it with guessed installation results.
error.visibleTruth: The discovery query did not produce a valid complete five-tool projection.
prohibitedClaims: Do not display the previous scan as if it were the failed request's current result.
error.freshness: The failed requestId is identified and prior results are visibly stale or cleared.
error.recovery: Retry creates a new requestId and performs the same bounded read-only scan.
error.correlation: The safe local error class is correlated to the failed requestId; raw command output is not displayed.

expired.behavior: Mark a superseded result as expired and prevent it from overwriting a newer request.
expired.visibleTruth: A scan completion arrived for an older requestId and was rejected from the current projection.
prohibitedClaims: Do not merge cards from different request identities or completion times.
expired.freshness: Only the newest started requestId is eligible to become current.
expired.recovery: Continue showing the newest active or completed request; no filesystem recovery is required.
expired.correlation: Both expired and current request identities remain in transient UI control flow only.

conflict.behavior: Highlight every tool with multiple canonical executable candidates and explain that no candidate was silently chosen.
conflict.visibleTruth: The bounded scan observed more than one distinct executable for at least one tool.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim compatibility, choose a preferred executable, or expose a configure action while installation identity is ambiguous.
conflict.freshness: Candidate counts come only from the newest accepted scan.
conflict.recovery: The user resolves the tool installation externally, then rescans; RU-001 changes no PATH or tool file.
conflict.correlation: The conflict and sanitized candidate source classes are bound to one requestId.

recovery.behavior: After a failed, timed-out, or superseded scan, explain that a clean rescan is the only in-app recovery action.
recovery.visibleTruth: No write or rollback is necessary because discovery is read-only and stores no retained scan history.
prohibitedClaims: Do not offer repair, install, update, configuration, credential, or restore operations in RU-001.
recovery.freshness: Recovery always creates a new requestId and never mutates an older result.
recovery.recovery: Run another bounded local scan; if it fails again, preserve the truthful per-tool failure states.
recovery.correlation: The recovery request receives its own requestId.

processing.behavior: Represent each bounded version probe as in progress while keeping configuration and remote-service controls absent.
processing.visibleTruth: Only local executable discovery and a bounded --version command may be processing.
prohibitedClaims: Do not imply that login, billing, API connectivity, model retrieval, updates, or configuration are processing.
processing.freshness: Processing belongs to the newest active requestId and expires when it is superseded.
processing.recovery: Each probe times out into a truthful per-tool result; the overall projection still completes when possible.
processing.correlation: Per-tool processing is aggregated under one requestId without persistent telemetry.

default.behavior: Inspect the selected first-party line for the exact desktop v2 contract, restore a remembered OS-credential-store session when possible, otherwise show one clear website sign-in action.
default.visibleTruth: No account value is current until the newest native projection succeeds; an undeployed or incompatible server remains visibly unavailable.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim that login, account data, billing data, or recharge is available, and do not show zero or sample numbers.
default.freshness: The newest requestId owns current account truth and successful data shows its local observation time.
default.recovery: Retry the selected line or start first-party website authorization; no password or API key is entered in the client.
default.correlation: Only the requestId and safe state cross IPC; credentials and raw server bodies remain native-only.

loading.behavior: Show a quiet current-request skeleton while the native layer validates bootstrap, restores or refreshes the session, and reads account projections.
loading.visibleTruth: The newest native request is unresolved; prior numbers are not current.
prohibitedClaims: Do not keep an old balance or price visually current while a newer request is unresolved.
loading.freshness: Only the newest requestId may produce current data.
loading.recovery: A failed request transitions to a closed safe error without inventing completion.
loading.correlation: Loading belongs to exactly one transient requestId.

empty.behavior: Keep the signed-in account visible while explaining that the server returned no usage or comparable ratio-price rows.
empty.visibleTruth: The server returned a successful but empty projection for the selected range.
prohibitedClaims: Do not convert missing usage or price rows into a zero-cost or free-service claim.
empty.freshness: Show the server data timestamp and selected range.
empty.recovery: The user may retry without converting missing data into zero.
empty.correlation: The empty result remains bound to its server requestId and data timestamp.

partial.behavior: Show each successfully validated account, usage, model, pricing or wallet projection independently and mark the missing section by name.
partial.visibleTruth: Only the named server projections completed successfully.
prohibitedClaims: Do not derive a missing official price from an actual price or a missing balance from cached usage.
partial.freshness: The page shows the native observation time; missing sections remain unavailable.
partial.recovery: Retry only the missing projection without erasing truthful completed sections.
partial.correlation: Each partial section retains its originating requestId.

error.behavior: Show a stable safe error class and hide unverified numeric account and billing values.
error.visibleTruth: The newest account request did not produce a valid projection.
prohibitedClaims: Do not parse a server message into a guessed balance, price, authorization, or payment state.
error.freshness: Any prior data is visibly expired and cannot be presented as current.
error.recovery: Retry creates a new requestId; authentication failures require the explicit authorization recovery path.
error.correlation: Only safe request and error codes may be shown; secrets and raw server bodies remain hidden.

expired.behavior: Replace account facts with an expired-session notice and remove active wallet and billing actions.
expired.visibleTruth: The desktop session or pending authorization has expired and current account truth is unavailable.
prohibitedClaims: Do not keep cached account, price, usage, or wallet data looking live.
expired.freshness: Expired data keeps only a visible stale timestamp if retained in memory for explanation.
expired.recovery: Start a new authorization through the system browser.
expired.correlation: The expired device session ID is never displayed or logged.

conflict.behavior: Explain authorization replay, already-used code, device revocation, or newest-request conflict without choosing a successful state.
conflict.visibleTruth: The server rejected the operation because the device authorization or session identity no longer owns the expected state.
prohibitedClaims: Do not treat an already-used or mismatched authorization as approved.
conflict.freshness: Conflicted credentials and results are immediately ineligible for current display.
conflict.recovery: Start a new single-use authorization request.
conflict.correlation: The user sees a safe conflict code and support requestId only.

recovery.behavior: Show the exact safe next step for backend unavailable, network retry, expired session, rejection, or revocation.
recovery.visibleTruth: Recovery has not completed until the corresponding server response succeeds.
prohibitedClaims: Do not auto-authorize, auto-recharge, or silently fall back to broad website credentials.
recovery.freshness: Recovery starts a new request identity and invalidates superseded results.
recovery.recovery: Follow only the action allowed by the stable native reason code.
recovery.correlation: Every future recovery attempt receives a new requestId.

processing.behavior: Show the non-secret short code, remaining approval window and a cancel action while the website decides the device authorization.
processing.visibleTruth: The device authorization is pending; approval, denial, cancellation, expiry and server-directed slow-down remain distinct outcomes.
prohibitedClaims: Do not put passwords, cookies, access tokens, refresh tokens, API keys, or final session credentials in a URL or visible code.
processing.freshness: The server-provided expiry owns the pending state and cannot be extended by the client.
processing.recovery: Cancellation or expiry requires a new authorization request; slow_down obeys the server interval.
processing.correlation: Only the authorization requestId and non-secret user code may be presented.

default.behavior: Show the fixed five-tool selector, two approved line choices, unavailable model step, and a deterministic preview summary for the current default selection.
default.visibleTruth: The page is planning only; it has not read configuration, contacted a server, accessed a credential, or established automatic-configuration support.
prohibitedClaims: Do not call the preview configured, connected, compatible, tested, or ready to apply.
default.freshness: The projection is compiled into RU-003 and has no remote freshness timestamp.
default.recovery: The user may change the selection or leave without changing the machine.
default.correlation: Each selection creates a transient requestId for the pure local projection.

loading.behavior: Reserve a bounded placeholder for a future model-catalog request while keeping apply disabled and all remote facts hidden.
loading.visibleTruth: RU-003 does not enter this state because it performs no network request.
prohibitedClaims: Do not retain a previous model or price as current while a future request is unresolved.
loading.freshness: A future newest requestId would own this state.
loading.recovery: A future failure returns to an unavailable model state without guessing.
loading.correlation: The reserved state belongs to exactly one future requestId.

empty.behavior: Keep the selected tool and line visible while explaining that no server model catalog is available.
empty.visibleTruth: No real model ID, price, or model recommendation was obtained.
prohibitedClaims: Do not render a sample or default model as a real account option.
empty.recovery: A later frozen server integration may replace the empty model step.
empty.correlation: The local selection requestId remains transient.

partial.behavior: Show the evidenced tool target fields and selected line root while withholding any endpoint or target that is not established, including DSH.
partial.visibleTruth: Only the named documented preview fields are available; model, credential, support, write, and connectivity facts are absent.
prohibitedClaims: Do not fill an unverified field from another tool adapter.
partial.freshness: The preview catalog is fixed to RU-003 evidence.
partial.recovery: Choose another tool or wait for a later verified adapter release.
partial.correlation: The partial preview belongs to the newest local selection requestId.

error.behavior: Reject an invalid local selection and show no preview or apply action.
error.visibleTruth: The pure projection did not accept the tool, line, or request identity.
prohibitedClaims: Do not fall back to an arbitrary tool, line, model, endpoint, or file.
error.recovery: Reset to the fixed first tool and first line without any side effect.
error.correlation: The safe local error is associated only with the rejected requestId.

expired.behavior: Discard a superseded selection result before it can replace the newest visible preview.
expired.visibleTruth: An older local projection no longer owns the selected tool or line.
prohibitedClaims: Do not merge the endpoint, file, or fields of different selections.
expired.freshness: Only the newest selection requestId is current.
expired.recovery: Continue with the newest projection; no file recovery is required.
expired.correlation: Expired identities remain transient and are not logged.

conflict.behavior: Keep apply disabled when tool identity, exact version, profile, target ownership, or external-change safety cannot be proved.
conflict.visibleTruth: The required future write preconditions are not satisfied.
prohibitedClaims: Do not silently choose an executable, profile, configuration owner, or merge result.
conflict.freshness: A conflict cannot be cleared by the static preview catalog.
conflict.recovery: A later exact-version adapter and transactional read-back flow must resolve it.
conflict.correlation: No secret-bearing or complete local path is included in conflict details.

recovery.behavior: Explain the missing backend, model catalog, secure credential helper, exact-version allowlist, and DSH adapter prerequisites by name.
recovery.visibleTruth: No rollback exists because RU-003 never begins a write transaction.
prohibitedClaims: Do not offer backup restore, repair, credential entry, or force apply in this release unit.
recovery.freshness: Recovery guidance is fixed to the RU-003 release boundary.
recovery.recovery: Wait for a later frozen integration or inspect the local tool discovery result.
recovery.correlation: No persistent operation or recovery identity is created.

processing.behavior: Reserve the future transaction state for encrypted temporary snapshot, guarded write, read-back, tool probe, and rollback while exposing none of those operations in RU-003.
processing.visibleTruth: No configuration operation is processing in RU-003.
prohibitedClaims: Do not animate or label the disabled apply control as if a write, test, or rollback has started.
processing.recovery: No transaction recovery is required because no transaction can start.

prohibitedClaims: Do not call the client production-ready, logged in, configured, signed, notarized, auto-updating, or connected to account data.

default.recovery: The user can move to another local destination or restart the application without restoring data.
default.correlation: Static guidance creates no remote or persistent operation identity.

loading.behavior: Reserve a skeleton only for a future signed remote readiness projection and keep all unavailable capabilities disabled.

prohibitedClaims: Do not show cached or sample remote facts while a future request is unresolved.

loading.recovery: A future failure returns to a truthful unavailable state.
loading.correlation: No request identity exists in RU-005 static pages.

empty.behavior: Explain that no account, model, price, signed-update, or release-signing evidence is available rather than filling the page with default values.

prohibitedClaims: Do not render absence as zero balance, free pricing, no updates, or successful signing.

partial.correlation: Static state has no request identity.

error.behavior: Show a safe client rendering error with no backend, credential, configuration, or update inference.
error.visibleTruth: The page did not render its local projection.
prohibitedClaims: Do not attribute an unclassified client error to the network, account, API, or configuration.
error.recovery: Restart the client; no data rollback is required because static pages write no product data.
error.correlation: Only a safe local error class may be shown.

expired.behavior: Mark any future remote readiness or update evidence stale and retain only compiled candidate facts.
expired.visibleTruth: No stale remote result is current.
prohibitedClaims: Do not keep an expired update, price, model, or account state looking live.
expired.freshness: Compiled facts remain bound to the app version; future remote facts require their own expiry.
expired.recovery: Return to current local candidate truth.
expired.correlation: Expired remote identities are not present in RU-005.

conflict.behavior: Prefer the stricter blocked state if implementation, backend, signing, or update evidence disagrees.

prohibitedClaims: Do not choose a favorable readiness or release claim from conflicting evidence.
conflict.freshness: Conflict persists until a later accepted decision and verified release unit.
conflict.recovery: Keep the capability disabled and update the governed evidence before release.
conflict.correlation: No secret or raw signing material is displayed.

recovery.behavior: Route the user to the exact local feature or explain which later backend or signing gate is required.
recovery.visibleTruth: Recovery has not completed until the named capability has verified evidence.
prohibitedClaims: Do not offer force-enable, unsigned auto-update, plaintext-key, retained-backup, or fake-login shortcuts.

recovery.recovery: Use only an available local destination or wait for a later verified release.

processing.behavior: Show processing only when the user has started a local scan or bounded connectivity check on its owning page.

prohibitedClaims: Do not animate login, billing, update, signing, configuration, or telemetry as processing.
processing.recovery: Return to the default static projection.

default.behavior: Show both approved line hosts, the DNS and TCP-443 scope, and one explicit start action with no prior result.

default.recovery: The user may start the bounded check or leave without changing the machine.

loading.behavior: Keep both line cards visible, mark them checking, and disable duplicate submission for the active request.

loading.recovery: Timeout and safe failures become per-line results.

partial.freshness: Both outcomes share one newest completion time.
partial.recovery: The user may retry or preview either line without a configuration write.

error.behavior: Reject an invalid or incomplete projection and clear prior results from the active state.

error.freshness: The failed request cannot become current.
error.recovery: Retry starts a new bounded request.
error.correlation: Only a safe local error class and failed requestId may be shown.

conflict.behavior: Reject any response with duplicated, missing, swapped, or unapproved line identity.
